Program Officer

Leadership Initiative for Youth Empowerment

Product & Project Management

Today
Easy apply New Featured
Lagos Full Time NGO, NPO & Charity NGN 150,000 - 250,000

Share link

Share on WhatsApp Share on LinkedIn Share on Facebook Share on Twitter

Job summary

The Program Officer will lead fundraising and resource mobilization efforts, identify funding opportunities, develop grant proposals, and build relationships with donors and funding partners. The role will also support programme coordination, project concept development, budgeting, implementation, and donor reporting.

Min Qualification: Degree Experience Level: Entry level Experience Length: 2 years Language Requirement: English Work Type: Full Time Working Hours: 8 to 5 Applicant Location: Nigeria

Job descriptions & requirements

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and pursue fundraising opportunities and potential donors.
  • Develop funding proposals, grant applications, and project concepts.
  • Build and maintain relationships with donors and funding partners.
  • Research, track, and maintain a pipeline of funding opportunities.
  • Develop project budgets and supporting proposal documentation.
  • Coordinate programme activities and prepare donor reports.
  • Support resource mobilisation strategies and partnership development.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Sciences, Development Studies, or a related field.
  • Experience in fundraising, grant writing, and resource mobilisation.
  • Strong proposal development, research, and report-writing skills.
  • Excellent communication, networking, and relationship-management skills.
  • Experience working with non-governmental organisations (NGOs) is an advantage.


Candidate Profile:

  • Preferred age range within 25–35 years.
  • Candidates residing in Okota, Isolo, and surrounding areas are preferred.
  • Female candidates are preferred. 


Location:Okota/Isolo, Lagos State

Remuneration: NGN 150,000–200,000 Monthly Gross
